caption:
# LibreOffice Writer GUI Interface

## Window Header

- **Application Title Bar**
  - Left: "LibreOffice Writer" icon and text
  - Center: "Untitled 1 - LibreOffice Writer"
  - Right: Window control buttons (Minimize, Maximize/Restore, Close)

- **System Information Bar**
  - Center: "Oct 22 20:40"
  - Right: System icons (including sound, network, and power)

## Application Menu Bar

- **Menu Items (Left to Right)**
  - File
  - Edit
  - View
  - Insert
  - Format
  - Styles
  - Table
  - Form
  - Tools
  - Window
  - Help

## Toolbar

- **Quick Access Toolbar (Above Main Toolbar)**
  - Icons for: New Document, Open, Save, Save As, Print, Find, Spelling and Grammar, and others.

- **Main Formatting Toolbar**
  - **Paragraph Style Dropdown**
    - Label: "Default Paragraph Style"
    - Dropdown arrow
  - **Font Selection**
    - Font family dropdown: "Liberation Serif"
    - Font size dropdown: "12 pt"
  - **Text Formatting Buttons**
    - Bold (B)
    - Italic (I)
    - Underline (U)
    - Strikethrough (S)
    - Superscript (A°)
    - Subscript (A_)
    - Font Color (A with color dropdown)
    - Highlight Color (A with highlight dropdown)
  - **Alignment Buttons**
    - Left Align
    - Center Align
    - Right Align
    - Justify
  - **List Formatting Buttons**
    - Bulleted List
    - Numbered List
    - Indentation Controls
  - **Other Formatting Icons**
    - Text Direction
    - Special Characters (Ω)
    - Link
    - Comment
    - Table
    - Drawing Tools (Pen, Shapes)

## Notification Bar

- **Blue Information Bar**
  - Left: Information icon (i)
  - Text: "Help us make LibreOffice even better!"
  - Right: "Get involved" button and "X" close button
  - Below: "Your donations support our worldwide community."
  - Right: "Donate" button and "X" close button

## Document Area

- **Ruler**
  - Horizontal ruler with measurement markings (1 to 18)
  - Vertical ruler with measurement markings (not fully visible)
  - Cursor position indicator (hourglass shape)

- **Document Page**
  - White page with default margins
  - Page corners have small triangular cursor indicators
  - No text or content present

## Sidebar

- **Vertical Scrollbar**
  - Located on the right side of the document area
  - Scroll handle with arrow indicator

- **Sidebar Icons (Right Side)**
  - **Formatting Painter** (paintbrush icon)
  - **Styles** (document with style icon)
  - **Navigation** (magnifying glass icon)
  - **Page Layout** (page icon)
  - **Object Properties** (A with pencil icon)

## Status Bar

- **Left Section**
  - "Page 1 of 1"
  - "0 words, 0 characters"

- **Center Section**
  - "Default Page Style"

- **Right Section**
  - "English (Hong Kong)"
  - Zoom control: "100%"
  - Zoom slider with minus, slider, and plus buttons
  - Page view icons (including page layout, outline, and others)

## Desktop Environment

- **Left Dock (Application Launcher)**
  - Icons for: Google Chrome, Thunderbird, Visual Studio Code, VLC Media Player, LibreOffice Writer, LibreOffice Calc, LibreOffice Impress, GIMP, Files, Software Center, Help, Trash

- **Bottom Dock (System Tray)**
  - Grid icon for application launcher
  - System tray icons (including sound, network, and power)
